items.text: “Kinyaŋ idwe luka Isirael kama ejaas Imidianin: akaulo kanun ŋes kiyanaarere jo mama ejaas ikonituŋa.”
Kolimok Musa ituŋa ebe, “Kokapanakisi icetuŋa kotomakus kanuka ejie, tetere elosete asurokin Midian, aitodol einyanane laka EJAKAIT mama ejai Midian.
Ŋukarete yesi ojie luka ŋiniteker elukumit, katekerin kere nuka Isirae!.”
Kwaŋin kolemunai kolukumin luka Isirael, luka ŋiniteker elukumit, kes ilukumin itomon ka luarei luakapakina kanuka ejie.
Kijuka Musa kes, luka niniteker elukumit, oiie, kes ka Pinekas okoku loka Eleasar esasedoti, oiie, ajaas iboro luka aibois nakalaunan ka arupepen nuka elala akanike.
Kitijioto Midian, kwape kicorakinia EJAKAIT Musa; koarata da nolikiliokit.
Koarata ikabakan luka Midian nepepe kalueekee:
Ebi, ka Rekem, ka Sur, ka Kur, ka Reba, ikabakan ikany luka Midian: koarata da Balaam okoku laka Beor kekilen.
Kijoreosi idwe luka Isirael aŋor nuka Midian ka ikeeedwe ludidik; konatasi da ibarenekee kere, ka isipaninikee kere, ka iborokee kere.
Kicweata kakim ireriakec kere kotoma aiboisio nueboiononoto, ka iidukurunukee kere.
Koyanaasi iŋatan kere, ka ideman kere, ituŋa ka itiaŋ da.
Koyaut luejoreunitai, ka ideman, ka iŋatan, mama ejai Musa, ka Eleasar esasedoti, ka ekodet laka idwe luka Isirael, mama ejaas iidukurun apuutona nuka Moab nuejaas ariri naka Yorodan ko Yeriko.
Koloto Musa ka Eleasar ka ikapolok kere luka ekodet, airiamun kakes kina kiidukurun.
Konyunyurik Musa ikeŋarenok luka ajore, ikapolok luka ilukumin ka ikapolok luka akwat, luapote kojie.
Kotema Musa kes atiar, “Ttaiarata kereka yesi aŋor kere?
Koany, apotu mm koinakis idwe luka Isirael adiakar kama ka EJAKAIT, kanuka ainerun naka Balaam, kakiro nuka Peor, kanuka nun da kojaun atular okodet loka EJAKAIT.
Aso do koara niniklliokit kodwe ludidik, koara da niniberu naejeni ekiliokit kanuka apero kaŋes,
Konye idwe lupesur, lumam ejenete ekiliokit kanuka apero kaŋes, kitajarata kanukus.
Kidukuroto yesi kina kiidukurun apaarasia akanykaarei: ŋin yenaarit ituŋanan, ŋin da yenetirorit yenearitai, kitalaunos kapaaran nakiwuniet kapaaran da nakikanyetekaarei, yes ka ijoreunokus.
Italaunete da nininapiro, ka nin kere yeniswamatai kemukule, ka yeniswamatai kajulo nuka akinei, ka iboro kere luiswamatai kakiro.”
Kolimok Eleasar esasedoti ikaiiok lualosito ojie ebe, “Ŋol ŋes ekisil loka aicorakinet naeeoraki EJAKAIT Musa:
Konye esabu, ka epuesa, ka aikomo, ka asua, ka adebe, ka asasin.
Ŋinibore yenimam akim enyami, itotorioto akim, eraun yenelai; konye italaunio kakip nuitesegaarete: kere da yenepedori akim ainyam idomakinete akipi.
Ilosete akusinapen kapaaran nakikanyetekaarei, iraunos da luilaete, akaulo kanun ilomarete oidukurun.”
“Kimar iŋatan luanatunio, ituŋa ka itian da, ijo ka Eleasar esasedoti, ka ikapolok luka ikalia luka lukapapa luka ekodet:
Kokorak da iŋatan toma atutubeta aareij mama ejaas ikaiiok luepiiriaka kojie lualosito oiie, ka ekodet kere:
Kitelem ikajiok lualosito ojie esolo kanuka EJAKAIT: idiopet kakwat akany, yenika ituŋa, ka aituk, ka asigiria, ka isipanin:
Kolem ŋes kotoma atutubetakec, koinak Eleasar esasedoti, araun ainakinet naedakakinitai naka EJAKAIT.

Kotoma atutubet da naka idwe luka Isirael ilemuni ijo idiopet kotoma ninikaisakany, naka ituŋa, ka aituk, ka asigiria, ka isipanin, kes luka ibaren kere, koinak Ilebin, luidarete ewema lokalaunan loka EJAKAIT.”
Kiswamata Musa ka Eleasar esasedoti kwape kicorakinia EJAKAIT Musa.
Iŋatan da, luedeunos konatan luayaŋaarete ikaiiok, emwaasi amerekekin alukumin akwat akanykape ka alukumin akaisakanykaarei ka alukumin akany,
Aituk alukumin akaisakanykaarei ka alukumin aarei,
Asigiria alukumin akaisakanykape ka alukumit adiopet,
Ka ituŋa kere ilukumin akaisauni ka ilukumin iarei, luka apesur numam ajenete ekiliokit kanuka apero kaŋes,
Atutubet nakerai akorakiner naka ŋul kalualosito ojie, arai etiaike amerekekin alukumin akwat auni ka akaisauni ka nukanykaarei ka akwat akany:
Esolo du loka EJAKAIT loka amerekekin kerai akwat akanykape ka akaisakanykaarei ka nukany.
Aituk da emwaasi alukumin akaisauni ka alukumin akanykape; kotoma kanun korai esolo loka EJAKAIT akaisakanykaarei ka nuarei.
Emwaasi asigiria alukumin akaisauni ka akwat akany; kotoma kanun koral esolo loka EJAKAIT akaisakanykape ka nadiopet.
Emwaasi ituŋa da ilukumin itomon ka lukanykape; kotoma kanul da korai esolo Ioka EJAKAIT ituŋa akaisauni ka luarei.
Koinak Musa Eleasar esasedoti esolo loarai ainakinet naedakakinitai naka EJAKAIT, kwape kicorakinia EJAKAIT Musa,
Atutubet naka idwe luka Isirael naatiakuni Musa kotuna luajiito,
(Atutubet da naka ekodet emwaasi amerekekin alukumin akwat auni ka akaisauni ka nukanykaarei ka akwat akany,
Ka aituk alukumin akaisauni ka alukumin akanykape,
Asigiria alukumin akaisauni ka akwat akany,
Kotoma atutubet naka idwe luka Isirael, kolem Musa idiopet kotoma ninikaisakany, ituŋa ka itian da, koinak kes Ilebin luedarete ewema lokalaunan loka EJAKAIT: kwape kieorakinia EJAKAIT Musa.
Kikunyut ikeŋarenok luapolokinito ilukumin luka ajore, ikapolok luka ilukumin ka ikapolok luka akwat neejai Musa:
Kolimokis Musa ebe, “Einara ikonikejaanakinak ikajiok lukidari isio, ido emamei yeneoliorit kasio.
Kiyau da ainakinet naka EJAKAIT, luadumu ninituŋanan, iboro luka esabu, ka asua, ka aikomon, ka igilun, ka itetio, ka abwakai, alucio ikositauon kakonyen nuka EJAKAIT.”
Kijaut Musa ka Eleasar esasedoti esabukec, ka lukisiro kere.
Esabu kere loka ainakinet naedakakinitai naainakinete EJAKAIT ikapolok luka ilukumin ka ikapolok luka akwat arai isekelin
itomon ka Iukanykape ka akwat akanykaarei ka akaisakany,
Kijaut Musa ka Eleasar esasedoti esabu loka ikapolok luka ilukumin ka luka akwat, koyanaut toma owema loka airiamunun, araun aisiitunet mama ejaas idwe luka Isirael kakonyen nuka EJAKAIT.
